{
  "pros": [
    "Highly customizable and flexible for various workflows",
    "All-in-one platform consolidating many tools",
    "Multiple task views (List, Board, Calendar) readily available",
    "Efficient and quick task creation (e.g., inline add)",
    "Intuitive drag-and-drop functionality for tasks",
    "Robust free plan for basic use"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Overwhelming and cluttered user interface for new users",
    "Performance issues (slowness, bugs) can be frequent",
    "Steep learning curve due to extensive features",
    "Pre-filled demo data creates initial clutter",
    "Tedious setup for some custom fields or options",
    "Lack of warnings for duplicating built-in fields"
  ],
  "overall_rating": 3.5
}
